Aspen Acres, Custer County. CIMT (NR Team 6). CIMT (RM Team 3) mobilizing. Twenty miles southwest of

Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (NW Team 8). Seven miles northwest of 
Lake City, CO. Timber, heavy slash and grass. Minimal fire behavior with creeping and smoldering. Area, road 
and trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire area yesterday. 
 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Transfer of command from CIMT (RM 
Team 2) to CIMT (RM Team 1) will occur tomorrow. Two miles north of Ouray, CO. Grass, brush and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior with flanking, backing and creeping. Numerous structures and critical infrastructure 
threatened. Evacuations, area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. CIMT (CA Team 8). Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed 
timber litter and timber. Moderate fire behavior with creeping, isolated torching and smoldering. Residences 
and communication infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred 
over the fire area yesterday. 
 
Fishhook, Medicine Bow-Routt NF, USFS. Transfer of command from CIMT (SW Team 1) back to the local

behavior with smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire area 
yesterday. 
Ferris, San Juan NF, USFS. Seven miles east of Cahone, CO. Timber and brush. Minimal fire behavior with 
smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Keystone, White River Field Office, BLM. Forty-five miles northwest of Meeker, CO. Brush, timber and 
dormant brush. Minimal fire behavior with creeping and smoldering. Residences threatened.
